title: Adobe Creative Suite Image Job
description: Schema for asynchronous image processing jobs submitted to Adobe Photoshop and related Creative Suite image APIs. Covers the full lifecycle of a job from submission through completion or failure, including input references, output references, and error details.

jobId.description: Unique identifier assigned to the image processing job upon submission

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the image processing job

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the job was submitted for processing

modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the job record was last updated

input.description: Reference to the input file used for this image processing job

href.description: URL or path to the input file in the specified cloud storage provider

storage.description: Cloud storage provider where the input file resides

type.description: MIME type of the input file

output.description: Reference to the output file location for this image processing job

href.description: URL or path where the processed output file will be stored

storage.description: Cloud storage provider where the output file will be written

type.description: MIME type of the output file to produce

width.description: Width of the output image in pixels

height.description: Height of the output image in pixels

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing file at the output location

outputs.description: List of output files produced when the job succeeds (for multi-output operations)

items.description: An individual output produced by this image processing job

input.description: Reference to the input file that generated this output

details.description: Additional human-readable detail about this output's status

href.description: URL to download the completed output file

storage.description: Cloud storage provider where the output file was written

type.description: MIME type of the output file

width.description: Actual width of the output image in pixels

height.description: Actual height of the output image in pixels

errors.description: List of errors encountered during job processing (populated when status is failed)

items.description: An individual error encountered during image processing

code.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the type of failure

title.description: Short human-readable title for the error

description.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of what went wrong
examples: The provided file is not a valid PSD document
